name: Plymouth's rod
slug: Plymouth's collapsible belt rod that lightning-transports people a set distance.
description: A collapsible rod about a foot long, carried in a telescope-style pocket case on Plymouth's belt. It has several turnable sections and a broad, rounded, three-pronged head at one end. Set for a convergence and a distance, it can be planted so that lightning transports people standing close to it.

log.summary: Plymouth sets the rod for the convergence and a 5.6-mile distance, plants it, and has everyone stand close. Electrical energy arcs around it, and lightning carries the group from the grassy knoll to the mountain above Langdale Stronghold; he had aimed for the front door. The rod comes out smoldering and sooty. He brushes it clean, slides it back into his belt, and says that a little farther off the result would have been quite bad.
